references.text: The continuation of the description of the crossbars, with five bars for the other side and five for the back of the tabernacle.
The fulfillment of the command to make crossbars of acacia wood, as described in the instructions.
Acacia wood is also used to build the ark of the covenant, showing the consistent use of this material in the construction of the tabernacle.
Acacia wood is mentioned among the gifts that were to be collected for the building of the tabernacle.
The planks that the crossbars were to hold together, also made of acacia wood.
Highlights the symmetry in God's plan by showing that the same construction principle applies to all sides of the sanctuary.
